title: Identification of indoles as potential endogenous ligands of ERRgamma and their modulation on drug binding.
authors: Shuai, Yuan-Yuan; Zhang, Hong-Yang; Chen, Rui; Wang, Bai-Ling; Ding, Ping; Dong, Yan; Sun, Ming-Ze; Wu, Xi-Shan; Xu, Yong; Zhang, Yan; Liu, Jin-Song; Wang, Na; Xu, Ting-Ting
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过生化、结构和分子动力学模拟鉴定吲哚类化合物为ERRgamma核受体的潜在内源配体，虽涉及蛋白-配体结合与MD模拟，但对象为核受体-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，仅间接相关。
abstract: Estrogen-related receptor gamma (ERRgamma) is an orphan nuclear receptor in the ERR subfamily that plays a crucial role in regulating energy metabolism. To date, no endogenous ligand has been identified for ERRgamma, posing a challenge for developing targeted therapeutics. Here, we identified that indole and skatole produced by the gut microbiota are potential endogenous ligands of ERRgamma using biochemical, cellular, structural, and computational approaches. Indole and skatole increased ERRgamma thermostability and directly bound to the ligand-binding domain (LBD) with a K(d) of approximately 1-2 muM but had no significant effect or weak inhibitory activity on the transcriptional efficiency. However, RNA sequencing revealed that ERRgamma could coregulate several lipid metabolism- and immune-related genes with indole, suggesting a role for ERRgamma in the indole pathway. Interestingly, indole and skatole differentially attenuated the activities of ERRgamma ligands: they both neutralized the agonistic activity of GSK4716, while indole reduced the antagonistic activity of 4-hydroxytamoxifen (4OHT) and GSK5182, and skatole affected the agonistic activity of endocrine disruptor bisphenol A (BPA). We further screened additional indole metabolites and analogs, resolved the complex structures of ERRgamma-LBD with these compounds, and conducted molecular dynamics simulations to determine their binding site and elucidate their binding mechanisms. This study identified potential endogenous ligands of ERRgamma, suggesting a novel link between the energy metabolism regulation and the indole pathway. Our findings highlight the need to consider endogenous ligands when designing and optimizing ERRgamma-targeted drugs.
abstract_zh: 雌激素相关受体γ（ERRgamma）是ERR亚家族中的一个孤儿核受体，在调节能量代谢中发挥关键作用。迄今为止，尚未鉴定出ERRgamma的内源性配体，这对开发靶向治疗药物构成了挑战。在此，我们通过生化、细胞、结构和计算等方法，鉴定出肠道微生物群产生的吲哚和粪臭素是ERRgamma的潜在内源性配体。吲哚和粪臭素增加了ERRgamma的热稳定性，并直接结合其配体结合域（LBD），解离常数（K(d)）约为1-2 μM，但对转录效率无显著影响或仅具有弱抑制活性。然而，RNA测序揭示ERRgamma可与吲哚共同调控多个脂质代谢和免疫相关基因，提示ERRgamma在吲哚通路中发挥作用。有趣的是，吲哚和粪臭素对ERRgamma配体的活性产生差异性减弱作用：两者均中和了GSK4716的激动活性，而吲哚降低了4-羟基他莫昔芬（4OHT）和GSK5182的拮抗活性，粪臭素则影响了内分泌干扰物双酚A（BPA）的激动活性。我们进一步筛选了其他吲哚代谢物和类似物，解析了ERRgamma-LBD与这些化合物的复合物结构，并进行了分子动力学模拟以确定其结合位点并阐明其结合机制。本研究鉴定了ERRgamma的潜在内源性配体，提示能量代谢调节与吲哚通路之间存在新的联系。我们的发现强调，在设计并优化靶向ERRgamma的药物时，需要考虑内源性配体的影响。
